description: In response to the Ombudsman scandal and deteriorating sovereignty, several EU member states and Nordic partners initiate a regional pact to jointly develop and govern public-sector AI systems for welfare, justice, and administration. The pact aims to restore trust through shared auditing, open impact assessments, and citizen oversight panels, creating a parallel governance track outside dominant US platforms. Early participation includes France, Germany, the Netherlands, and Finland, with technical coordination hosted in Luxembourg.
